about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you are into gigs and live music, you might enjoy [[Music]], [[Musical Theatre]], or [[Rock]].

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For board games and a quiet night in, [[Gaming and Roleplay]], [[Book]] and [[Film]] are all great places to meet others with similar interests.

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: Since you are into football and running, you might like [[Cycling]] for getting out and about on wheels, or [[Walking]] if you fancy exploring at a steadier pace. Have a look at [[Sport]] to browse all of Northumbria Sport's clubs and find teams that fit your routine.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: That sounds like a relaxing day. Since you enjoy film and the cinema, you might like the [[Film]] society.

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: Since you enjoy gaming, you might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]] or [[Esports]]. What kind of games do you usually play with your mates?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: That sounds like a lot of fun, and NSU has plenty going on with [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] if you love big nights out. For societies, you might enjoy [[Beats Cartel Dance]] or [[Music]].

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: For long walks and getting outdoors, you might like [[Walking]] or [[Climbing]].

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply:
That sounds lovely and peaceful. 

What course are you studying, or what else are you into, so I can find a few societies that fit you?

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you prefer to avoid. What sort of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: Since you enjoy reading and films and prefer quiet nights in, [[Book]] and [[Film]] might be right up your street.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply:
If you like live music and indie bands, you might enjoy [[Music]] or [[Rock]]. 

What kind of nights out or venues do you usually go for?

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You would be very welcome to join [[Ukrainian]], which is open to anyone interested in the culture.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: Being a mature student is quite common, and the [[Mature Students]] society is a great place to meet others in the same boat.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: It is completely understandable to feel worried about money, but there is support available to help you through this. You can check [[Cost of Living]] for handy ways to save and find support, or take a look at [[Food Pantry]] if you need a little extra help with groceries.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear that you are going through this. You can get help with food and money worries through [[Food Pantry]] and [[Cost of Living]].

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: Try not to panic, as help is available. You can contact the [[Advice Centre]] for free, confidential guidance on academic misconduct and what to expect next.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: That sounds really stressful, but you can certainly get help with housing issues. Have a look at the [[Advice Centre]] for guidance on dealing with landlords and solving housing problems.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply:
You can check out [[Swimming]] for training and competing with Northumbria Sport. 

Have a look at its card for details on training times, memberships and how to join.

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: You can check out [[Football]] for team training and matches, and you can also take a look at [[Sport]] to browse all the other sports clubs on offer.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: There is an ice hockey society you can check out. Take a look at [[Ice Hockey]] to see what it is about and how to get involved.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply: That is a great goal for your first year here. What kind of things do you enjoy, or would you prefer something like a fitness class or a team sport?

do I pay to see a doctor.message: I'm an international student. Do I have to pay to see a doctor here?
do I pay to see a doctor.reply: You do not have to pay for standard appointments with a doctor through the NHS, though you might pay a health surcharge when you apply for your visa. Take a look at the [[NHS Guide]] for more details.

how does the NHS work.message: I've just arrived from abroad and I don't understand how the NHS works. Can you explain?
how does the NHS work.reply: You can see a doctor for free through the NHS, though you might pay a healthcare surcharge when you apply for your visa. Take a look at the [[NHS Guide]] for more details on how it all works and how to register with a local doctor.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: You might like [[Hooked By Crochet]] and [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] for getting together with others who share your crafty interests.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: You can find the contact details and how to join by looking at [[Hooked By Crochet]] and [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]].

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: That is brilliant, and we have both an outdoor group and a Northumbria Sport club for that. Have a look at [[Climbing]] and [[Mountaineering]] to see what suits you best.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: You can find all the details and how to sign up by checking [[Climbing]] or [[Mountaineering]].

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: Yes, there is [[Gaming and Roleplay]] which is a great fit for tabletop role-playing games and board games.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: If you want to know what it is like, have a look at [[Gaming and Roleplay]] where you will find more details.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply: That sounds great. Since you are into films, you might want to check out [[Film]].
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: To see their contact details and social media links, you can take a look at [[Film]].
